helpful: Blinded candidates preserve the inputs needed for independent scoring.
Historical statpack recovery prevents grading old figures against a newer build.
Capture markers distinguish unseen results from empty or failed retrieval.
notes: The default uv cache was read-only; setting UV_CACHE_DIR under /tmp allowed historical statpack recovery with --no-sync and no installation. gemini-baseline has uncaptured results; that limits inspection without itself establishing leakage.
